notes.title: NEXT FEST, NEW FRIENDS, AND EVEN MORE SLIPPERY ADVENTURES
notes.content: [h3][b]Hello, beloved penguins! It’s your host Alican again![/b][/h3][p]Since our first devlog last month, things have been incredibly lively! We joined Steam Next Fest and showcased our demo for the very first time. Huge thanks for your amazing support and the thousands of new wishlists! Our Discord community has been rapidly growing with your participation, and thanks to your fantastic feedback, we've continued improving the game every single day. (Of course, I might have spent a lot of time "testing" by sliding around and slapping my teammates, but let’s keep that between us! 😊) Now, let’s dive into some exciting updates we've made since the demo![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Snowboards are Here. Penguins Just Got Cooler![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597481/cb33d2e44387745e625162337c2e86e796e61eb8.gif"][/img][/p][p]Penguins can finally snowboard! We now have an alternative to painfully sliding on our bellies. You can grab a snowboard from the in-game shop and glide stylishly down the slopes with acrobatic moves. Of course, slapping me instead of sliding is still an option. 😊[/p][p][/p][h3][b]More Colors, More Vibrant Penguins[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597481/6e23f1c7a3d143939c8e16e5db22a54d8409b388.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’ve added 20 brand new colors to character customization! Now everyone can make their penguins even more unique. Pink penguins, green penguins, even overly bright orange penguins are now possible! If you’d like to debate which color penguin deserves the most slaps, let me know in the comments. 😊[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Brand New Inventory and Camera System[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45597481/ab397c2818d3e72ac5642998e8306c14c71aa545.gif"][/img][/p][p]Our in-game inventory interface has been completely revamped. Everything is now much cleaner and easier to use. The camera has also been redesigned from scratch—make sure to take plenty of photos and share them on Discord! A special slap from me awaits the penguin with the best pose![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Additional Improvements and Much More[/b][/h3][p]We've fixed numerous minor bugs, optimized performance, and made the gameplay experience smoother than ever. Now when you pause the game, your sliding penguin stops respectfully too. Your mouse cursor no longer disappears, your camera won’t get stuck, and overall, everything is a lot more enjoyable.[/p][p]We've removed minigames to make the game experience more focused. You can now also cancel fishing anytime you want. Say goodbye to the days of endlessly waiting for fish![/p][p]Due to popular demand, we've introduced some mysterious new drinks. Try them if you’d like your penguins to feel a little tipsy! (Careful—if you spin too much, penguins might topple over!) Additionally, we’ve added a Patreon button to the main menu, so you can now easily support the game if you wish.[/p][p]Lastly, thanks once again to everyone who supported us during Steam Next Fest, shared their feedback, and joined our fun! The game is getting better every day, all thanks to you.[/p][p]How have you been lately? Don’t forget to share your funniest moments with us![/p][p][/p][p]Much love,[/p][p]Alican 🐧❤️[/p]

notes.title: Small Fixes, Shiny Fish, and Global Penguins — Demo Update is Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! 🐧[/p][p]We just pushed a fresh update to the demo with a bunch of little improvements and fixes. Here’s what changed while we were definitely not just sliding around for fun:[/p][list][*][p]Valuable fish are now a bit harder to catch. Gotta earn those coins![/p][/*][*][p]There’s a new sign in the village that shows the names of all players. Yes, you’re famous now.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that was causing chaos in some mini-games.[/p][/*][*][p]Items you sell now properly leave your inventory. No more ghost bananas.[/p][/*][*][p]Fish you catch now glow based on their value. Shiny fish are good fish.[/p][/*][*][p]Lobbies now show which country they’re hosted in. Global penguin party.[/p][/*][*][p]Private rooms now appear in the list, but you still need an invite or a code to join them.[/p][/*][*][p]You’ll no longer see your own name in the messages tab. Mystery solved.[/p][/*][*][p]Added localization for some previously silent objects.[/p][/*][*][p]General optimization work to keep things smooth and cozy.[/p][/*][/list][p]As always, thanks for playing and for all the feedback you’ve been sending. More updates are on the way![/p][p]With love,
The Penguins at CO’s Entertainment 🐟[/p]
